neighbours.label: the space token before a number giving a physical size (height, length, width) of a creature or person
fire: The young giraffe already stood nearly 6 feet tall when it was a week old.
Adult saltwater crocodiles can reach 7 meters in length.
Napoleon was said to be short, but he actually measured about 5 feet 7 inches.
This species of catfish grows to 2 meters long in the wild.
Our son is now 4 feet tall and still growing fast.
The largest manta rays have a wingspan of 7 meters across.
At birth the calf weighed little and was only 3 feet long.
The tallest player on the team stands 7 feet 1 inch in his socks.
quiet: The young giraffe was born in the zoo on 6 March and is doing well.
Adult saltwater crocodiles can lay 50 eggs in a single nest.
Napoleon was said to be short, but he actually won 7 major battles that year.
This species of catfish was described in 2 separate papers.
Our son is now in grade 4 and loves reading.
The largest manta rays were counted 7 times by divers last season.
At birth the calf was the 3rd born in the herd that spring.
The tallest player on the team scored 7 points in the final quarter.

notes: card: top 32 peak mostly on ' ' before a digit after 'standing just', 'can be', 'height was', 'grows to'. Near misses keep the space+digit but the number is a count, date or price.
